item: Library-window test: the same on every OS (row 151)
summary: The replace-after-log-removal test injected errno 13 and met a real Windows held-file refusal first (an open connection holds the -wal). It now injects EIO and stands in for the log removal on Windows only; a new case injects winerror 32 at the log on every OS and expects the fixed held words, the plaintext original and the earlier connection still refused.
